metadata.description: Initialize project structure, configure paths, and set development mode

purpose.primary: Establish project foundation and development mode

entry_criteria.description: Can always enter P0 - it's the entry point

exit_criteria.description: Requirements to leave P0 and enter P1
exit_criteria.validation: working_memory.json is valid JSON with required fields

development_mode_configuration.description: This is where the critical development mode choice is made

prompt_to_user.question: What type of project is this?

options.label: Personal / Exploratory / Agile
options.description: Architecture can evolve with implementation. New requirements can be added freely. Design is a living document.

options.label: Enterprise / Approved / Regulated
options.description: Architecture is locked after approval. Implementation must conform to design. Changes require formal approval.

follow_up_if_rigid.question: What level of drift is acceptable?

follow_up_iteration_budget.question: How many development/test iterations before forced architecture review?

state_changes: current_phase set to P0 (then P1 on exit)

on_entry: Explain the two development modes (flexible vs rigid)
critical_actions: MUST ask about development mode - this affects all subsequent phases
MUST create working_memory.json with all required paths
on_exit: Explain what comes next (P1: Functional Analysis)
